title: ...land in a foreign country where you don't speak the language
desc: Navigate customs, transit, and connectivity safely upon arrival.
todos: Connect to official airport Wi-Fi or activate an international eSIM/data plan.
Withdraw a small amount of local currency from an official airport bank ATM.
Confirm local transit options or use verified ride-share/official airport taxis.
Save hotel address written in the local native language on your phone.
Keep passport, entry customs declaration forms, and valuables in secured daypack.
